facts.text: The Red Sea EDITION is on Shura Island within the Red Sea Project in Saudi Arabia.
facts.excerpt: Nestled on Shura Island within the visionary Red Sea Project in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, The Red Sea EDITION

facts.text: Jiwa Beach Club is a Bali beach club-inspired seaside venue serving Southeast Asian cuisine.
facts.excerpt: Jiwa Beach Club is a Bali beach club-inspired seaside dining and entertainment experience

facts.text: Jiwa Beach Club offers a hands-on Discovery class in Balinese cuisine and culture, plus sunset bonfires and Drum Sessions.
facts.excerpt: Inspiring afternoons include a hands-on, personalized Discovery class, immersing guests in the techniques, ingredients and wisdom of Balinese cuisine and culture.

facts.text: Central is a restaurant that nods to New York City's Grand Central Station and serves American classics and comfort food.
facts.excerpt: Central invites guests to come and go as they please, enjoying a culinary crossroads of American classics and comfort food crafted with local ingredients

facts.text: The Lobby offers an Aperi-Tea service with tea-based cocktails and small plates.
facts.excerpt: The Aperi-Tea service reinvents the classic presentation of tea and cake with a curated selection of tea-based cocktails and nutritious small plates

facts.text: The spa performs Omorovicza signature rituals.
facts.excerpt: Omorovicza signature rituals are performed in five treatment rooms, including one couple

facts.text: The spa has a Rejuvenation Area with indoor and outdoor plunge pools, infrared and bio saunas, a snow shower and heated loungers.
facts.excerpt: Guests can enjoy the Rejuvenation Area with indoor and outdoor plunge pools, infrared and bio saunas, snow shower, and heated loungers.

facts.text: The gym has Technogym equipment, a martial arts studio and reformer Pilates.
facts.excerpt: Featuring Technogym equipment, a martial arts studio, reformer Pilates, and indoor/outdoor workout spaces

facts.text: The gym offers open-water swims and Aquafit board classes.
facts.excerpt: Guests can participate in open-water swims, Aquafit board classes, and sunrise movement sessions led by expert trainers

facts.text: Some suites have private outdoor pools and showers.
facts.excerpt: Select suites feature fully equipped kitchens or kitchenettes and offer a deeper connection to Shura Island

facts.text: Guest rooms have views to the sea or the golf course.
facts.excerpt: Punctuated with panoramic window with views to the sea or the golf course beyond

facts.text: The hotel has an infinity pool with Red Sea views and a private beach with cabanas.
facts.excerpt: Infinity pool with Red Sea views

facts.text: The hotel has tennis and paddle courts, a volleyball court and a Watersports Center.
facts.excerpt: State-of-the-art fitness center, tennis and paddle courts, and a volleyball court

facts.text: Transport from Red Sea International Airport to the hotel is included in the room rate.
facts.excerpt: Transportation from Red Sea International Airport (RSI) to The Red Sea EDITION is included in the room rate.

facts.text: The property can only be reached by shuttle from RSI Airport.
facts.excerpt: The property can only be accessed via shuttle transportation from RSI Airport with a premium sedan as the default option.

facts.text: The drive from Jeddah airport takes approximately six hours.
facts.excerpt: offering a scenic approximately six-hour journey through the stunning Saudi Arabian desert
